product_name: Bajaj Life Magnum Fortune Plus III
regulatory_descriptor: A Unit-linked Non-Participating Individual Life Savings Insurance Plan
key_benefits: Maturity Benefit = Fund Value (including Top-Up Premium Fund Value, if any) on maturity; payable as lump sum or structured payout over up to 5 years (market-linked, not guaranteed).

Life insurance cover throughout the policy term; Death Benefit = higher of Prevailing Sum Assured or Regular Premium Fund Value, plus top-up component, subject to Guaranteed Benefit of 105% of Total Premiums received.
Return of Mortality Charges (ROMC) added back to the Fund Value at maturity (subject to all due premiums paid, not surrendered/paid-up).
Loyalty Additions from the 10th policy year; Maturity Booster for existing customers and/or those choosing auto-pay.
Family Benefit for existing-customer families; choice of multiple premium bands.
Partial withdrawals and Systematic Partial Withdrawal (SPW) allowed after 5 policy years; choice of portfolio strategies (Investor Selectable, Target Asset Allocation, Automatic Transfer).
Optional Waiver of Premium rider; flexibility to change PPT, reduce premium, increase policy term.
riders_available: Riders are available (the brochure lists a Waiver of Premium rider and refers to a rider list); specific rider UINs are not enumerated in this sales literature.

eligibility.premium_payment_term: Limited premium (with option to change PPT)
eligibility.note: Product-eligibility table is referenced ('all references to age are as on last birthday'; minor life vests at 18) but the numeric entry/maturity-age, sum-assured and premium-band values are not captured in the parse. Verify against the policy document.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the policy document (electronic or otherwise); not applicable to policies with tenure of less than a year. Refund subject to proportionate risk premium, medical/stamp-duty expenses and repurchase of units at the cancellation-date price.
key_terms.grace_period: 30 days for yearly/half-yearly/quarterly frequencies; 15 days for monthly frequency.
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death by suicide within 12 months from commencement or revival (whichever later), the nominee receives the Fund Value as on date of intimation of death (charges other than FMC/guarantee charge recovered after death are added back). No other death exclusion.
key_terms.lock_in: 5-year lock-in: partial withdrawals only after 5 policy years; surrender during lock-in moves Fund Value (less discontinuance/surrender charge) to the Discontinued Life Policy Fund and terminates risk cover.
key_terms.maturity_benefit_condition: Maturity Benefit is the market-linked Fund Value, not a guaranteed amount; Loyalty Additions and Maturity Booster are conditional add-ons.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits 'may be applicable on premiums paid and benefits received as per the prevailing tax laws' — consult a tax consultant; GST per prevailing tax laws.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Risks of Investment in the Units of the Plan (market-risk / NAV-may-go-up-or-down statement)
Funds 'do not offer a guaranteed or assured return' disclosure

claims_marketing_must_support: Any 'guaranteed' claim is bounded to the Guaranteed Benefit of 105% of Total Premiums received — not a guaranteed maturity value/return.
Maturity Benefit equals the market-linked Fund Value — any value/return figure must carry the 'illustrative, not guaranteed, 4%/8% assumed' caveat.

Loyalty Additions, Maturity Booster, ROMC and Family Benefit are conditional (in-force, all due premiums paid, existing-customer / auto-pay criteria, exclude top-ups) and must be stated with those conditions.
Maturity Booster is offered ONLY to existing customers at purchase and/or those opting for auto-pay — must be so qualified.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT promise 'guaranteed returns', 'assured returns' or a fixed maturity corpus — this is a unit-linked plan; investment risk is borne by the policyholder and funds do not offer a guaranteed or assured return.
Do NOT use 'bonus' language — it is non-participating.
Do NOT imply liquidity in the first 5 years.
Do NOT present the 4%/8% illustrative figures as expected returns or upper/lower limits.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
Do NOT state a loan facility — no loan is available under this plan.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Unit-linked Non-Participating Individual Life Savings Insurance Plan'

Mandatory ULIP market-risk disclosure (premiums subject to capital-market investment risk; NAV may go up or down; policyholder responsible for decisions; product name does not indicate quality/future prospects/returns).
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms, charges and exclusions.

gaps: Numeric eligibility (entry/maturity age, min/max sum assured, premium bands) not present in the parse.
Rider UINs are not enumerated in this brochure (only that riders, including a Waiver of Premium rider, are available).
